# ADR-3276: AWS tagging_compute: Public EC2 with elastic IP for app 4

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public instances bypass private network controls.

## Decision

Apps SHALL NOT place a public EC2 with elastic IP for app 4 (AWS-tagging_compute-4) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer private instances behind load balancers.
